watch.summary: The streamer hilariously copes with his favorite Valorant team getting dominated by jokingly predicting the opposing team will be exposed for cheating in two years.

beats.what: Streamer accuses the opposing pro team of cheating as they win another round.
Streamer claims that two years from now a scandal will reveal they were using illegal software.
Streamer shouts in dramatic denial that 'something is not right' while rejecting his team's 0-8 scoreboard.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Two years from now it's gonna come out that these guys, you know, used... something is not right, okay?!
watch.why: The streamer's dramatic cope and mock outrage over his team getting stomped 0-8 creates a relatable gaming joke. However, without knowing the esports background or team rivalries, the humor is fairly standard gaming banter.
